authorization: User requested timing-fairness audit and GPU rerun if historical measurements include cold startup.
dataset: same 900 simulated report records: 200 gene, 700 species; source bytes verified against report inventory
algorithm: historical gene auto mode m0, species k-closest placement m1 K10; JC distance d2 and force-binary retained
definition: PHYLIP-to-FASTA adapter time (including decompression for compressed inputs) plus synchronized native FASTA-file-to-tree time after CUDA EAGER initialization and TBB warmup

known_limits: GPU-preinitialized fresh CLI process per record; not a retained DIPPER session benchmark

other comparator histories remain heterogeneous; no hardware-normalized universal speedup claim
pilot: two representative original/cold/warm matched-seed trees are byte-identical
